serviceCharge.note: 20% gratuity is added to all party packages.

addOns.name: 360 Camera
addOns.description: Add to a VIP package. Guests stand on a platform while the camera spins 360 degrees, making a shareable video with slow motion, effects, filters and music.

faq.q: Can we bring outside food or drinks?
faq.a: No outside food or drinks are allowed with the exception of cake or cupcakes.
Anyone under the age of 16 must be accompanied by a parent or guardian during normal business hours.

faq.q: Is a deposit required for parties?
faq.a: A deposit and signed agreement are required for all group functions.
20% gratuity is added to all party packages.

faq.q: How do I reserve a party?
Can we rent out the whole venue?
faq.a: Larger groups can reserve the entire venue for their festivities. Contact the Strikers team to learn more.
